text: The system shall allow users to upload requirement documents.
The system shall parse repository source code into functions and classes.
The system shall generate an explainable traceability matrix.
The system shall show linked code for each requirement with confidence score.
The system shall create projects with name and optional GitHub URL.
The system shall reject non GitHub repository URLs.
The system shall support repository reindex for an existing project.
The system shall store requirement text versions after each upload.
The system shall store embeddings for requirements and code units.
The system shall retrieve top candidates using vector similarity search.
The system shall rerank retrieved candidates before creating final links.
The system shall show project level match percentage and counts.
The system shall provide a safe reset endpoint for local development only.
The system shall show friendly message for stale requirement URLs.
The system shall skip noisy files like minified bundles and verification pages.
